description: JSON-RPC 2.0 over the job's WebSocket. Generated from shared/rpc.py.
title: DBX_leaning job/app RPC methods

bye.summary: Clean shutdown; distinct from a dropped socket.

cancel.summary: Ask the job to stop. Answered, which v3 could not do.

params.capabilities: object: methods this side answers, e.g. {'cancel': {}}

hello.summary: First frame. Which run this is, the seq it is picking up from, and the job's protocol version and capabilities.

ping.summary: Application-level keepalive, not a WS protocol ping.

replay.summary: Resend [from_seq, to_seq]. The only live backfill path.

telemetry.summary: A batch of envelope messages. The bulk of all traffic.

x-protocol-compatibility: job MAJOR == app MAJOR and job MINOR <= app MINOR
